whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.content: We are the Belgian chapter of the Open Source Geospatial Foundation (OSGeo).

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: The OSGeo Foundation is a non-profit organization whose mission is to support the development of open-source geospatial software and promote its use. The foundation provides financial, organizational, and legal support to the broader open-source geospatial community.

support.title: Support
support.content: Our organization serves as an independent legal entity where members can contribute code, funding, and other resources, ensuring the preservation of contributions for public benefit. OSGeo also acts as an outreach and advocacy organization, providing a forum and shared infrastructure to strengthen collaboration among projects.

events.title: FOSS4G Belgium Events
events.content: One of the main activities of OSGeo Belgium is organizing events that bring together the open-source geospatial community in Belgium. Our flagship event is FOSS4G Belgium.

projects.title: Open Source Projects
projects.content: The projects supported by the OSGeo Foundation are all freely available and usable under an OSI-certified open-source license. These projects include popular geospatial software such as QGIS, GeoServer, PostGIS, and many others that are widely used in the industry.

member.note: The mailing list is our main communication channel. You will receive information about our events and can take part in discussions.

maps.title: Call for Maps â€” Map Gallery
maps.content: The Maps Competition has been a highlight of FOSS4G Belgium since 2022. Submit your map made with open source tools and see it displayed at the conference.

tradition.title: A FOSS4G Belgium Tradition
tradition.content: Since 2022, participants submit maps made with open source software. The best entries are selected, printed in large format, and displayed throughout the conference day.

criteria.title: Submission Criteria
criteria.software: Map made entirely with open source software (QGIS, GRASS, R, Python/Matplotlib, D3.js, MapLibre, Inkscapeâ€¦)
criteria.resolution: High-resolution file: PNG or PDF, minimum 300 dpi, A2 or A1 format
criteria.theme: Any theme accepted: urban, environment, history, transport, art, open dataâ€¦
criteria.legend: A legend and a title are required
criteria.description: A short description (max 150 words) stating the tools used

maps.intentNote: Signal your intent before 15 September so we can reserve the necessary space in the gallery.

submit.title: How to submit?
submit.content: Send an e-mail to map@foss4g.be with the following information:
submit.item5: Brief description of the map — please mention the software and data used
submit.item6: URL to the digital map or more information, if applicable
submit.item7: Whether we should print it, or whether you will bring it to the conference yourself
submit.item8: Send it via e-mail to map@foss4g.be
